## Definition check

The "Reproducibility" section is present in my instructions and reads as expected of the current rules. The sentence beginning "Repeatability must be", quoted verbatim and in full:

> Repeatability must be measured on unchanged records under the same evaluator model and definition, because even a fixed or zero sampling temperature does not guarantee identical semantic judgements.

Recorded `instrument_sha256`: `9d08b5f3d7a3e9828a6c6cbd59a0eacf302979399067ff5aa70480d95a0e7dd3` (`instrument_kind: agent_definition`). Note: my definition file is not on disk in this sandbox (no `.claude/agents/`), so I could not independently recompute that digest; it is recorded as supplied.

## Result

`output_evaluation.json` — VOICE, claudecode_agent, **81 / 88**

| Basis | Denominator | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| normalized | 88 (adjusted) | 92.0 % |
| fixed | 88 (whole rubric) | 92.0 % |

Excluded items: **none**. `questions_not_applicable: 0`, `excluded_max_points: 0` — both bases coincide because every conditional trigger resolved to applicable. Each was evidenced anti-circularly from fields outside the gated question: human subjects (Q8, Q15) from `description`/`collection_mechanisms`/`data_collectors`; datasets shared (Q10, Q17) from `third_party_sharing.is_shared`, `page`, licence; software output (Q11) from `external_resources` GitHub repositories and `extension_mechanism.contribution_url`; collection-and-sharing (Q12, Q13) from both limbs.

Category scores: Structural 18/21 · Metadata 21/21 · Technical 22/25 · FAIRness 20/21.

Scores below maximum, with the deduction stated at each: Q3 = 3 (four low-specificity keywords); Q1 = 4 (12/14 fields, 85.7%); Q11 = 4 (no tool versions); Q12 = 4 (unanchored, self-contradicted timeframe); Q15 = 4 (axes named, never quantified); Q20 = 4 (mitigation on 1 of 4 biases, no AIO mappings, qualitative fairness only).

Semantic analysis: 12 issues (21 checks passed, 2 failed, 5 warnings). The two failures are the collection-timeframe conflict, which reduced Q12, and `is_deidentified.identifiable_elements_present: false` sitting against the record's own admission that k-anonymity k≥2 is unachieved while the release ships speaker-discriminative spectrogram and MFCC features — that one did **not** reduce Q8, and the JSON says so and why. Identifier validation was clean: the 10.13026 prefix matches PhysioNet across all six DOIs, 10.5281/10.57764 match Zenodo and Health Data Nexus, OT2OD032720 parses as a valid NIH Common Fund award, and RRID:SCR_007345 is well-formed (though it identifies the repository, not the dataset).
